_doc: Russian-language storefront search synonyms. Application-side expansion: query word lower-cased, looked up here, and the values are appended as OR-terms to the boolean MATCH query. Phase 9 will add an admin-managed UI; for Phase 7 this is the source of truth. PRODUCT §12.4.
_brand_to_inn: Soviet-era and modern brand names mapped to international non-proprietary names (INN). The values are what the catalog stores in product/ingredient names.
_indication_to_symptom: Plain-language complaints mapped to indications and symptom names.
_cold_family: Common-cold cluster — these collapse together at the storefront level (PRODUCT §12.4 example).
_throat_family: Throat / cough cluster — note: dry vs wet cough are NOT collapsed (PRODUCT §12.4).
_latin_to_cyrillic: Latin spellings of common INNs — customers sometimes type them.
